hook: *"Why should we hire you?"* - say this

slides.title: Don't list every quality
slides.body: "I'm hardworking, honest, dedicated..." sounds like everyone else.

slides.title: Match 2 needs from the job post
slides.body: Read the job description. Pick the 2 things they need most.

slides.title: Prove each with one example
slides.body: "You need X. In my internship I did Y." Short, real, specific.

slides.title: End with eagerness
slides.body: "I'm ready to learn fast and contribute from week one."
